Project name: Hinkley Point C New Nuclear Power Station
Description: The proposal is for a nuclear power station with two nuclear reactors capable of generating a total of up to 3,260MW of electricity at Hinkley Point C and associated development.
Proposed new nuclear power station, located adjacent to existing station at Wylfa A, on the Isle of Anglesey.

Location: Land approximately 2 km northeast of Faversham and 5 km west of Whitstable on the North Kent Coast.
Description: Solar photovoltaic array, and electrical storage and connection infrastructure, with a generation capacity of greater than 50 MW
